question: Should exact-head CI success become an enforced admission requirement, or should AGENTS.md describe it only as a maintainer process prerequisite?
rationale: The PR presents CI-first ordering as a required contract, while the checked-in admission implementation does not enforce it; choosing between documentation correction and workflow enforcement changes the intended operational guarantee.

options.title: Enforce the CI gate
options.body: Require a successful CI result for the exact PR head before review dispatch and add focused coverage for successful, pending, and failing states.

options.title: Document the current process
options.body: Keep the command-trigger behavior and rewrite the section so it does not claim that CI-first ordering is automatically enforced.

recommendation.title: Enforce the CI gate
recommendation.body: Require a successful CI result for the exact PR head before review dispatch and add focused coverage for successful, pending, and failing states.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing repository contract assigns explicit merge authority to Bobby and the choice defines review policy.
